name: Balatonszepezd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Balatonszepezd (a white and blue shield with an arrow and a fish) above the name BALATONSZEPEZD in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
